translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Wengena oseneno magi duto,
kendo ita osewinjo tiendgi maber.
Gima ungʼeyo, an bende angʼeyo;
kik upar ni afuwo.
To Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ema daher mondo awuogo
kendo mondo anyis Nyasaye gik mane chunya.
Un to uumo adiera gi miriambo;
uchalo jothieth ma ok nyal thiedho tuo!
Kudwaro nyiso ni uriek
to mad koro ulingʼ alingʼa kar wuoyo!
Koro winjuru ane gima awacho;
chikuru itu ne ywakna.
Ere gima omiyo uwuoyo marach kuom Nyasaye?
Koso uparo ni miriambou biro konyo Nyasaye?
Bende Nyasaye nyalo yie kodu
kudwaro loko adiera bedo miriambo?
Bende doyud adiera kuomu kononou?
Bende duwuonde kaka uwuondo dhano?
Obiro kwerou ratiro
kapo ni udew wangʼ ji.
Donge tekone biro goyou gi kihondko?
Donge mbi mare biro bwogou?
Ngeche muthoro mangʼenygo onge tich mana ka buch kendo;
wecheu yomyom mana ka agulni mag lowo.
“Lingʼuru kendo weyauru awuo;
mondo gima dwaro timorenano otimre.
Angʼo madimi abed e chandruok,
ka atiyo gi ngimana mana kaka an ema ahero?
Kata ka onega, to pod abiro keto genona kuome;
omiyo pod abiro mana wacho wechena e nyime.
Chutho, mano ema biro kelona resruok
nikech onge ngʼama okia Nyasaye,
manyalo hedhore michopi e nyime.
Chik iti mos mondo iwinj wechena;
kendo yie mondo iwinj gik ma awacho.
Kaka koro aseikora dwoko wach makora,
angʼeyo ni ubiro kwana kaka ngʼama kare.
Bende ngʼato kuomu nyalo donjona ni an jaketho?
Ka en kamano,
to abiro lingʼ kendo kata tho ayie tho.
“Yaye Nyasaye, yie itimna mana gik moko ariyogi
mondo kik apondni.
Gol lweti oko kuoma
kendo iyie igolna masichegi mabwoga.
Eka iluonga e nyimi kendo abiro dwoki,
kata iyiena awuo mondo idwoka.
Richo gi ketho adi ma asetimo?
Nyisa kethona gi richona.
Angʼo momiyo ipando wangʼi
kendo ikawa kaka jasiki?
It yien ayiena ma yamo teroni to isando nangʼo?
Mihudhi motwo ma yamo tero, to ilawo nangʼo?
Idonjona gi weche malit,
moriw koda ka richo mane atimo kapod an rawera.
Irido tiendena gi nyororo;
kendo iluwo bangʼa e yorena maluwo duto,
koketo kido e bwo tienda mondo onyis kamoro amora maluwo.
“Omiyo koro dhano rumo mos mos kaka gima otop,
mana ka nanga ma olwenda ochamo.”
